subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Arctic foxes are a species with two distinct seasonal forms.
• Summer Arctic foxes have dark brown fur that provides camouflage against tundra soil.
• Winter Arctic foxes have white fur that makes them nearly invisible against snow.
• Winter Arctic foxes have thicker fur with dense undercoats for insulation.
• This extra insulation helps winter foxes survive in temperatures below -40°F.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a difference between summer and winter Arctic foxes. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Summer and winter Arctic foxes may belong to the same species, but they are quite different.
choices.B: Summer Arctic foxes have dark brown fur, whereas winter Arctic foxes have white fur.
choices.C: Winter Arctic foxes have thick white fur with dense undercoats to survive extreme cold.
choices.D: Arctic foxes are a species with two distinct seasonal forms: summer foxes and winter foxes.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a difference between summer and winter Arctic foxes, noting that while summer foxes have dark brown fur, winter foxes have white fur.
